results.summary: The binding census was settled in iteration 3. This iteration added the scenario census: 28 scenarios against 18 bindings, 17 covered, 1 uncovered, raised as R5-P2-001.
The declared target is a file set, not a spec folder with a checklist.
VIB-HK-003 and VIB-HK-028 both passed live for the advisor path, so the pre_agent advisor claim at guards-and-hooks.md:131 has a verdict row behind it.

The two parity defects this lineage carries (R1-P2-004, R1-P2-005) are unchanged and both have live scenarios that pass: VIB-HK-021 for the cleanup hook and VIB-HK-012 for the overlay guard, so neither is a runtime break.
No feature catalogue covers this file set.

The verdict table was read in full: 27 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 OPERATOR-ONLY, 26 from runner rows and 1 from the hand-driven hop, every runner row dated 2026-11-15 after the hand-over hardening merge. The gap is the uncovered session-start binding, raised as R5-P2-001.

noveltyJustification: weightedNew = 1 (one P2) plus weightedRefinement 1.5 (three carried findings refined at 0.5x: R1-P2-001 narrowed by the code comment at spec-gate.mjs:73-75, R4-P2-003 narrowed by VIB-HK-015/008/009, R3-P2-002 confirmed by VIB-HK-016) against weightedTotal 20, the accumulated active set after this iteration (1 P1 = 5, 15 P2 = 15). The one new finding is a cross-reference result no single dimension owned: the scenario census against the binding census leaves exactly one uncovered binding.
